$comment: genUI round 4 (Board, a macro over reorderable Lists): the drop rule of a kanban Board, HAND-AUTHORED and replayed by packages/exponential-ui/src/list-reorder.test.ts (the TS reference the web renderers use) and apps/desktop/crates/eui-core/tests/list_reorder.rs (the core, so gpui and the natives through the FFI); Swift and Kotlin replay a Board drag end to end through the core (ListReorderTests). A Board expands to one reorderable List per column (catalog/macros.json `Board`), each carrying the internal prop `board` = the Board's id: reorderable Lists sharing a `board` trade rows. boardDropSlot = where a card drag drops: `columns` = the Board's Lists in order with their box across (`left`, `width`) and their RENDERED cards (`rows`: `key`, `top`, `height`, as list-reorder.json's), `drag` = the dragged card's key, `x`/`y` = the pointer. The column under the pointer takes the drop (in the gap between two columns, or past the first or the last, the NEARER column; a tie = the earlier). In it, the card under the pointer decides, else the NEARER card (a gap between cards, above the first, below the last; a tie = the earlier): its upper half = before, its lower half = after; over the dragged card itself = no drop (null); a column with no cards takes the drop with no card (`{column}`). Cards never nest (depth, group and maxDepth do not apply). An unknown dragged key = null. `move` = the TARGET column's List fires its `move` with {id, before | after: key} (nothing for an empty column) and the Board's macro adds the column's `value` as `column`: {id, column, before | after}. Every renderer paints the drop as a List drop (list-reorder.json): the 2px primary line + ring on the card's edge; an empty column = the into highlight over the column's List box; the lifted copy follows the pointer on BOTH axes (x = pointer - its press offset + `LIST_LIFT_OFFSET`). The core paints ONE entry per drag (`list_drag_paint`): its `list` = the List under the pointer (so a native's per-List overlay draws the copy and the drop there), `row` = the dragged card (dimmed in its own column). The host applies the move (the Board never reorders its data). Layout: the columns sit in one row that scrolls sideways (`overflowX: auto`); a column is at least 280 px wide (`flexBasis` 0, grows on a wide screen, never shrinks: phones scroll).

boardDropSlot.name: same column: over the dragged card = no drop
another column: upper half of a card = before
another column: lower half of a card = after
another column: above its first card = before the first
another column: below its last card = after the last
an empty column takes the drop with no card
the gap between columns = the nearer column (left)
a gap between two cards = the nearer card
a gap nearer the card below = before it
the gap between columns = the nearer column (right)
left of the first column = the first
right of the last column = the last
